summary: TELUS filed a 6-K with its Q3 2026 earnings release disclosing a transformation strategy that includes monetizing non-core assets, with near-term priority on accelerating the sale of TELUS Health and TELUS Agriculture Consumer Goods, proceeds earmarked for debt reduction. No buyer, price, or timetable was disclosed. An $800 million pre-tax non-cash goodwill impairment at TELUS Health reflects the active divestiture process. A multi-year efficiency program targets ~$900 million annualized savings exiting 2028; net debt/EBITDA was 3.6x. Watch for a formal sale process launch or stalking-horse bid.
